summary: Page 1 matches the official Jan 2018 ENCS PDF well, but Page 2 has a severe TIN/Name cell collision at the top, blank Schedule 1 Tax Rate values, missing DST/ATC reference table, and 49 raw developer cell IDs used as field labels in forms/forms-schema.json.

defects.where: Page 2 header TIN and Taxpayer's Name row
defects.what: TIN prints as uncombed free text ('00012345300000') and Taxpayer's Name starts inside the TIN column immediately concatenated onto the TIN ('00012345300000SANTOS, JUANA DELA CRUZ-MARIA...').
Tax Rate cells print blank even when ATC (DS101), Tax Base, and Tax Due are populated.
Long name, address, Other Party Name, and Item 12 TIN collide with comb ticks.
Official BIR 2000 Jan 2018 ENCS Page 2 includes the two-column Documentary Stamp Tax (DST)/ATC reference table (DS010-DS132); printed sheet leaves the lower half blank.
49 field labels in forms/forms-schema.json are raw developer cell IDs (e.g. 'sched1:txtTaxBase0', 'sched1:txtTaxRate0', 'sched1:txtTotalDue1') instead of plain-language labels.
Reads 'Page 1' on Page 2, which matches the exact typo printed on the official BIR 2000 Jan 2018 ENCS PDF.

shared_changes_wanted: neon-4 (try/forms-shared-print): comb-tick collisions on long name/address/Other Party Name/TIN
open_questions: Should the Page 2 DST/ATC reference table be added to html-frozen/2000-dst-2018/ to match the official PDF?
